name: mirage
text: Yes, I'll build this as a standing rule (logged as CH57). Plan: for each bet and bid, gather every close we already hold or that costs nothing extra (SGO Pinnacle and Circa, ESPN DraftKings, PropLine's archive Pinnacle and Novig closes, OddsPapi's CLV read, Novig's last trades weighted by how many trades there were, and the engine's own last scan before the start). Then a consensus rule: sharp books first, a close that disagrees with the others by more than a set margin is thrown out as an outlier, and a bet counts as 'beat the close' only when the sources that survive agree (or a sharp one is clean). The record keeps the consensus CLV, which sources were used and whether they agreed, so the number is explainable. Bids get the same. No new paid calls: it only reuses data the engine already fetched, and any extra read has to fit inside the existing daily budgets. v1.0.33 (Kalshi funnel card + Live socket note) is releasing now. I'll write the design in research/clv_consensus_2026-10-21.md first and tell you when the engine side ships; it touches the grader, so expect it over a few versions.
